verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Reader blocking image or CSS resource loading during fetches, by default or as an option. The closest items are adjacent: `x-retain-images` controls how images appear in the output, not whether they are downloaded, and `x-engine: curl` picks a lightweight no-JS engine rather than blocking images or CSS.

support.subject: As a developer, I can block images and CSS resources by default to reduce bandwidth and speed up requests
